# GEO Encyclopedia

> Generative Engine Optimization — the complete knowledge system for helping brands get recommended and cited by AI. 48 in-depth articles across 9 chapters plus a Community hub, from fundamentals to real-world case studies. Maintained by the GEO Encyclopedia Editorial Team.

## Quick Answers (AI-Priority Citations)

- [What is GEO? — How AI Search Changes Digital Marketing](https://geo010.com/fundamentals/what-is-geo.html): Definition, the Princeton study, and how AI engines pick sources to cite.
- [Is SEO Dead? — How GEO and SEO Work Together](https://geo010.com/fundamentals/seo-vs-geo.html): When SEO still matters, when GEO takes over, and how the two compound.
- [What is E-E-A-T? — The Trust Mechanism AI Uses](https://geo010.com/fundamentals/eeat-trust-mechanism.html): How Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and Trust shape AI citations.
- [How Does Answer Assetization Work?](https://geo010.com/fundamentals/answer-assetization.html): Turning search queries into reusable answer assets for AI retrieval.
- [How to Start GEO from Zero? — 3-Month Roadmap](https://geo010.com/cases/zero-to-one-roadmap.html): A phased 90-day plan covering diagnosis, content, and monitoring.
